notes: ACCESS: plain direct fetch throughout, no proxy needed. robots.txt names no Claude/anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot agent (only Bytespider is disallowed). The assigned /ae/en/ root 302-redirects to the real UAE English locale /en-uae/; all links use /en-uae/. TREE: taken from Magento GraphQL, not scraped from the nav. availableStores gave store_code 'en' (UAE En); categories(filters:{}) returned all 147 categories and I walked every one of them, so the furniture sweep is exhaustive. Furniture lives in five departments - SEATING, TABLE, BEDROOM, STORAGE, OUTDOOR. There is no Office, Kids/Nursery or bathroom-furniture department (BATHROOM is towels, robes, mats and accessories only), and no wardrobe/armoire node beyond STORAGE > CABINETS & CLOSETS. COUNTS: the PLP is a Magento 2 PWA Studio SPA whose grid is Klevu infinite scroll. I rendered table/dining-tables.html in a real browser and confirmed the page publishes no count text at all - nothing matching /\d+ (products|items|results)/ anywhere in document.innerText - so a rendered header is genuinely unobtainable here and qty must come from structured sources. I used TWO independent ones for every leaf: (1) Magento GraphQL products(filter:{category_uid}).total_count and (2) the storefront's own Klevu category-merchandising API (typeOfRequest CATNAV, apiKey klevu-162393374404713664 read from the site's languageSwitcher GraphQL field, endpoint eucs26v2.ksearchnet.com/cs/v2/search) - the exact API the PLP itself calls to build the grid. They agreed exactly on 31 of the 32 furniture leaves. RULE-1 TRAP AVOIDED: Magento categoryList.product_count was NOT used - the prior pass proved it 3-5x inflated on this site. Control categories reproduce that pass's live-verified numbers: Chandeliers 9 = 9, Vases & Vessels 42 vs 43 then (one product retired since). SANITY CHECKS: all 32 leaf URLs were put through GraphQL urlResolver and each returned type=CATEGORY with exactly the category id I had counted (0 bad), so there is no Magento silent parent-serve behind any row. Counts range 1..49 and change per category, so nothing is a site-wide constant, and none is a suspicious round number. A second full read of all 32 counts minutes later showed zero drift. STORAGE's four children 8+8+8+3=27 equal the STORAGE parent total 27 exactly. Klevu was enumerated to exhaustion on Cabinets & Closets: 8 records, 8 unique product ids, 8 unique SKUs (the two identically named FRITZ CABINET tiles are genuinely different SKUs), confirming totalResultsFound counts distinct products rather than variants. No qty came from counting hrefs. THE ONE DISAGREEMENT: Dining Tables, Klevu 27 vs GraphQL 26. I enumerated and diffed both record sets - the extra Klevu record is SKU WSE1311 'TULIP II ROUND DINING TABLE', which does not exist in the storefront catalogue (products(filter:{sku:{eq:"WSE1311"}}).total_count=0) and whose PDP renders an empty page in a live browser. It is a stale Klevu index entry, so 26 is the shoppable total; the row is flagged. EXCLUDED, with reasons. Seating > SOFA COVERS (4): furniture covers, a section-1 care/parts exclusion. Seating > LUSCIOUS COLLECTION (25, seating/luscious-cloud-sofas) and the top-level LUSCIOUS LIVING (id 166333): a named marketing product collection - I enumerated it and every record is a 'Luscious ... Sofa Set' already counted under Sofas / Sectional Sofas, which is exactly why the Seating children sum to 224 against a parent total of 194. Top-level LIVING ROOM (162 products, id 101026) and DINING ROOM (id 101028, url all-dining-room): cross-cutting room landing pages with no children - I enumerated LIVING ROOM and it mixes sofas, tables, cabinets, chandeliers and wall mirrors that are all already counted in the product-type departments, so recording them would both double-count furniture and drag in lighting and mirrors. NEW IN, SALE, THE CENTURIAL EDIT and the ~15 hidden '... EDIT' categories: section-3 navigation junk. Hidden duplicates with include_in_menu=0 and no route from the nav - TABLES id 62217 (1 product, 'Kuruma Side Table') and ACCESSORIES id 98523 (8) - dropped as catalogue artefacts. Outdoor > OUTDOOR ACCESSORIES (4): enumerated - two outdoor trays and two LED lanterns, not furniture. Outdoor > UMBRELLAS (1): a parasol, not on the section-1 furniture list. Also out of scope: all of DECOR, LIGHTING, RUGS, BATHROOM, BED LINENS and BEDDING ESSENTIALS (which is where mattress and pillow protectors sit), FESTIVE and GIFTING. Beds was enumerated to confirm it holds bed frames only, no mattresses. NAMING: sub-categories are the site's own node names; the site's misspelt 'OCCASSIONAL TABLES' is written 'Occasional Tables', and Outdoor's 'SEATINGS' and 'TABLES' are written 'Outdoor Seating' and 'Outdoor Tables' to keep them distinct from the Seating and Table departments.
